title: Fake Bank Fraud Department OTP Theft Attempt
description: Scammer poses as bank fraud agent, creates urgency, and requests the user to read back a 6-digit SMS OTP code.
dialogue: Hello, this is the security department from your bank. We noticed an unauthorized transfer attempt of 450 euros on your account.
To block this fraudulent transaction immediately, I just sent a security verification code to your mobile phone via SMS.
Please read me the six-digit code you just received so I can verify your identity and cancel the charge right now.
